research_limit: Admission-only source-distinct external native obligations; no G2 claim or target-specific method tuning before new protected failures and original-native verification.
history_check: Exact case-insensitive repository names absent from V41 PREQUERY and V4 HISTORICAL_REPOSITORIES at parent commit; bounded accessible-record check only, no comprehensive unfamiliarity claim.

metadata_method.search: GitHub search_prs(query='fix',state='closed',sort='updated',order='desc',topn=20) for each exact repo in declared order
metadata_method.inspect: For each returned PR number, GET /pulls/{number} and /pulls/{number}/files?per_page=100&page=1 in returned order, at most 12 entries with title starting fix case-insensitive per repo. Retain rejection metadata and reasons; inspect only metadata projections.
metadata_method.qualifier: Merged PR with one or more modified existing production .py and one added or modified author .py test under tests/ or test_ filename; 1 to 3 production Python changes, combined production additions <=8 and deletions <=8; exclude renamed/removed changed files and changes touching pyproject.toml, setup.py, setup.cfg, tox.ini or requirements/; complete nonpaginated file list required.
metadata_method.tie_break: First qualifying PR in returned search order per repository; no post-source substitution and no second PR chosen after viewing native outcomes.

source_authority: Bind base/head SHAs and each changed test file Git blob ID before reading source bodies. Source-bearing API responses are projected to metadata and never forwarded as patches or PR bodies.
roles: First two source-distinct native-admitted PRs in declared repo order are TRAINING and SEALED_HELDOUT. Hold future source and outcomes unopened until training method is frozen.
author_source_protection: Freeze exact upstream base and author head; apply test-only author overlay to original base for native FAIL witness; no repaired head production supplied. Reject wrong Git source/mode/content/authority or source mutations.
science_requirements: Native original FAIL with authentic author-protected assertion on training; unchanged candidate search/budget; later source-distinct future under actual native oracle; physical ablation, cold restart and equally informed ledger/coding-agent needed separately. Neither admissibility nor a native FAIL establishes G2.
negative_controls: Wrong source OID, altered test blob, zero required node, skip/deselection, wrong source import, path escapes and run timeout must fail closed.
prior_science: V15 exposed-source bounded native composition preserved; clean itsdangerous admission 297/297 and 71/71 original authority regressions preserved. G2-G6 UNKNOWN.
out_of_scope: No change to frozen methods/verifiers, external repository write, production merger, service deployment or external action permission.
